description: This source file defines classes and functions for interacting with the Azure Foundry Agent Service API, including configuration, request transformation, environment validation, error handling, and completion routing. It handles both synchronous and asynchronous communication with the service, manages authentication via Azure AD tokens, and provides integration points for streaming and request/response processing.
